work: The Long Dress In One Piece
heading: Liji 36 · Shen Yi 深衣 · The Long Dress In One Piece · Shen Yi 1 … Shen Yi 6

items.text: While your parents and grandparents are alive, wear the long dress with its border embroidered.
items.quote: while his parents and grandparents were alive, (a son) wore the dress with its border embroidered.

items.text: If only your parents are alive, wear the long dress with a blue ornamental border.
items.quote: If (only) his parents were alive, the ornamental border was blue.

items.text: If you are an orphan, wear the long dress with a white border.
items.quote: In the case of an orphan son, the border was white.
